Under the practice-internal sense (DEF-NATURAL-REASON-PRACTICE-INTERNAL) the reading bridge fails and the fideist bundle survives (needsNaturalReasonIsShared); the defeat is therefore exactly as strong as the shared reading of the council text. The existing shared bridge, all-nonshared profile and mixed actual witnesses form a checked structural EM fork; named uniform coverage remains open. The exact shared-bridge negation is now the alternative endpoint, derived from all-nonshared plus an actual move or from mixed witnesses. The original mixed prose horizon reconstruction and source claims are preserved, not silently identified with the modest audience sibling.
